extraction.name: OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning
extraction.description: Enhancements to Open Whisper-style Speech Models (OWSM) by integrating YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset, and developing a scalable data-cleaning pipeline.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The Open Whisper-style Speech Models (OWSM) project integrates YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset with a Creative Commons license, and cleans it using a scalable data-cleaning pipeline.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YODAS (YouTube-Oriented Dataset for Audio and Speech) provides 370k hours of audio in 149 languages, with unsegmented long-form recordings and text transcriptions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A three-step data-cleaning pipeline: 1) Resegmentation using CTC segmentation algorithm, 2) LID-based filtering, and 3) CTC-score-based filtering.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (labels, ratings) were created by aligning audio and text using pre-trained OWSM-CTC models and filtering based on LID and CTC scores.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Considerations related to converting raw annotations into final labels include uncertainty and disagreement analysis based on CTC confidence scores.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Public toolkits and models, including OWSM-CTC v3.2, fastText for text-based LID, and ECAPA-TDNN for spoken LID.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The cleaned YODAS data, pre-trained models, and all associated scripts will be publicly released via the ESPnet toolkit.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and models aim to advance open research in speech processing, promoting transparency and reproducibility.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The raw YODAS data contains noisy annotations and potential biases, which are mitigated through the data-cleaning pipeline.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Known limitations include data generalization limits and quality issues, but the dataset and models are designed to be open and reproducible.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset and models can be used for training, testing, validation, and fine-tuning speech foundation models, with usage guidelines provided upon release.
